objective: Compute a least-cost active-power dispatch for a diesel-plus-PV-plus-battery microgrid over a short horizon.

title.en: REL-TASK-024 — Economic active-power dispatch in a microgrid
title.ru: REL-TASK-024 — Экономическая диспетчеризация активной мощности в микросети

objective.en: Dispatch diesel generation and a battery to serve load with PV at minimum diesel cost.
objective.ru: Задать дизельную генерацию и батарею для покрытия нагрузки с PV при минимальной стоимости дизеля.

instructions.en: Use microgrid_dispatch_case. Choose battery_mw for each period, where positive means discharge and negative means charge. Respect battery power/SOC limits and diesel pmin/pmax. PV may be curtailed but load shedding is not allowed. Minimize diesel variable cost and report dispatch by timestamp plus total_cost. Any battery schedule achieving the minimum cost is accepted; feasible but more expensive schedules receive partial credit by cost gap.
instructions.ru: Используйте microgrid_dispatch_case. Выберите battery_mw для каждого периода: положительное значение означает разряд, отрицательное — заряд. Соблюдайте ограничения батареи по мощности/SOC и ограничения дизеля pmin/pmax. PV можно ограничивать, отключение нагрузки не допускается. Минимизируйте переменную стоимость дизеля и укажите dispatch по периодам и total_cost. Принимается любой профиль батареи с минимальной стоимостью; допустимые, но более дорогие решения получают частичный балл по разрыву стоимости.

submission_schema.dispatch: object mapping timestamp to diesel_mw, battery_mw, pv_curtailment_mw, soc_mwh, shed_mw
submission_schema.total_cost: diesel energy cost over the horizon

hard_constraints: The submitted battery schedule, re-simulated by the evaluator, must respect SOC bounds and serve all load without shedding.
Per-period diesel, SOC, curtailment, and shedding values must be consistent with the submitted battery schedule; total_cost must match the re-simulated cost.
Any feasible dispatch is admissible: equal-cost alternative optima receive full score, suboptimal feasible dispatch receives partial credit by cost gap.
Unknown extra answer keys are infeasible.

metrics.name: feasible
metrics.description: Whether the re-simulated battery schedule satisfies SOC and load-serving constraints and the submission is internally consistent.

metrics.name: score
metrics.description: 1.0 at the optimal cost; otherwise max(0, 1 - cost_gap/optimal_cost).

metrics.name: cost_gap_usd
metrics.description: Achieved cost minus the enumerated optimal cost.
